title: The Coordinated Sermons
description: Coordinated talking points appeared in forty-one parish sermons across Veltria last Sunday. The Archbishop's office issued guidance that has spread from Thornfeld to Sevagrad. This isn't informal pastoral concern — it's a campaign, and it is moving conservative rural voters.

title: Constitutional Draft — Religious Provisions
description: The Church's campaign is targeting three specific provisions: state religious neutrality, education curriculum authority, and hospital governance. The draft language on each is being contested line by line.

title: Budget Allocation — Church Programs Impact
description: Any change to the Church's institutional role has budget implications. Vostane has modeled the fiscal impact of secularization provisions on the health and education ministries.

title: Vael Consortium — Economic Briefing
description: Vael's consortium has released an economic forecast projecting capital flight if certain constitutional provisions pass. The report is self-serving. It is also being read by every business editor in the country.

title: Kolvar — Response Required
description: Kolvar's people are waiting for an answer. The committee deadline is approaching. If you're going to deal, it has to be now. If you're not, you need a strategy for the thirty votes you're turning down.
